content:
BUILT CoLAB celebrated its 4th anniversary on 20 September!

To mark another year of activity, and as has become customary, this was a time for the team to come together, with the organisation of teambuilding activities such as a Peddy Paper around Porto, lunch and a social party in the office, and we also had the presence of some of our associates.

Thus, in a year in which we have seen the consolidation of our presence in the market with the establishment of partnerships with more companies and institutions, and an increase in the number of employees, we continue on our path ever stronger to fulfil our mission in favour of the Twin Transition of the AEC sector.
